latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(controls): Add UpdateAutoSuggestBoxSuggestions call on MenuItemCollection change by @scanfing in https://github.com/lepoco/wpfui/pull/1696
* fix(tray): support Unicode for NotifyIcon.TooltipText by @chucker in https://github.com/lepoco/wpfui/pull/1706
* feat(controls): Implement `SpinButtonPlacementMode.Compact` for `NumberBox` by @chucker in https://github.com/lepoco/wpfui/pull/1709
* fix(controls): Change order of triggers for Button by @dkuaf in https://github.com/lepoco/wpfui/pull/1702


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lepoco/wpfui/compare/4.2.1...4.3.0
